verdict.rationale: Token2 ships fido2-manage, an open-source libfido2-based utility with command-line tools alongside an optional GUI, plus JSON/CSV export of device info and relying parties. It also offers PowerShell/Graph API automation for bulk-registering FIDO2 keys in Entra ID, so scripted, non-interactive use is plausible. However, nothing documents running these in CI pipelines or unattended, and the 'headless watcher' only launches the GUI. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline usage docs, non-interactive flags or exit-code documentation, guidance on unattended runs given that physical keys must be present, and independent hands-on corroboration.
